ns2:course.label: CAS Project
ns2:course.description: Individual study of a problem in library or information science; forms the culmination of the Certificate of Advanced Study program. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. Only eight hours will apply to the Certificate of Advanced Study. Prerequisite: Admission to Certificate of Advanced Study program in library and information science; submission of "Request to Enroll in LIS 593 - CAS Project" form.
